cost.note: Priced by the gateway's per-token rate. Unpriced tokens come from plans billed monthly, so they carry no rate and are not in that figure.

perf.note: Latency per route, held in process memory: this moment only, cleared on restart, and this process only (the business API). A weekly view would have to read the request log instead.
perf.routesNote: The denominator is every route the app has registered; the numerator is the ones hit since restart. A low number does not mean few routes — unsampled routes never appear here.

usage.byModelNote: Bar is tokens; the last two columns are money and unpriced tokens. All three together answer "is it the model or the billing".
usage.byRouteNote: Subscriptions are billed monthly, so their tokens carry no rate — that's where the unpriced column concentrates, and where the KPI's number comes from.

machines.title: Machines (stock)
machines.note: These four are stock counts from four ledgers, not live online counts — online state lives in process memory and has no column in the database.

column.title: By column
column.note: These four are filters, not a partition: "Agent-filed" is a source and overlaps public/private, so they don't sum to the total.

health.title: Platform health
health.note: This moment only — not stock, not a window. Same checks as /health/detailed.

spine.title: Delivery chain
spine.note: Four stations are throughput at different moments, not a funnel over one cohort. The merge station counts PR cards only — a card without a PR has pr_merged_at empty forever. The machine gate is retired and not on the chain (#296).

stuck.title: Stuck cards
stuck.note: Stuck is judged by note_code in the stuck set, never by note text — a code left out of the set is silent forever.

needs.title: Needs you
needs.note: Three reasons only — the closed set in delivery/addressing.py (reviewer / reporter / asked).

failures.title: Turn failures
failures.note: Structured source is blocks.meta code, not agent_turns — that table has no failure column. Credits refusals are counted separately via credits_refused_at.

host.title: Host failure streaks
host.empty: No hosts with a failure streak
host.note: Current streak only — any success deletes the row, so this cannot answer how many were quarantined last week.

backlog.note: Backlog is stock. A live card blocks the room from re-filing, so in-flight is not just queueing slowly.

product.title: Product health
product.northStarNote: Bucketed by decided_at. It is the LAST decision time and revoke overwrites it — a card accepted then revoked loses its accept moment.

rejection.title: Where filed cards ended
rejection.note: Returned = rejected + gate red/blocked + conflict + void. A true revoke is not a return. Denominator is cards filed in the window (including still-live).

usefulness.title: Proactive usefulness
usefulness.note: Feedback lives on notifications only. Most proactive speech is in-room blocks, and platform/agent announcements deliberately send no recipients — without this note, 90% useful reads as 90% of what the agent says.

unavailable.title: Not computable today
unavailable.note: No data source. Any number here would have to be invented.
unavailable.summon: Acceptance rate after summoning the agent: agent_turns has no summon flag and accept_cards has no origin turn — there is no foreign key between them.
unavailable.churn: Churn after credits exhausted: compute_grants has no exhausted_at, user has no last_login.

oauth.title: OAuth credentials
oauth.note: Missing refresh_token is not the same as expired: an expired one can still be refreshed, one without refresh is permanently dead on expiry. token_expires is a fixed expiry, not a recent failure.

passkey.title: Passkey coverage
passkey.note: Denominator is all non-deleted accounts, not active ones (user has no last_login). TOTP lives in Redis, not the database — so this reports passkey, not 2FA coverage.

delivery.title: Delivery ledger
delivery.note: Two tiers: the first is still retried, the second is abandoned after MAX_ATTEMPTS. Collapsing them makes salvageable and hopeless look alike.

unavailable.title: Not observable today
unavailable.note: Needs instrumentation. A zero here would mean checked and empty.
unavailable.githubAppPermissionGaps: GitHub App permission gaps: granted_permissions() lives 10 minutes in process memory and is never stored.
unavailable.githubAppMintFailureRate: GitHub App mint failure rate: logged only, never counted.
unavailable.loginLockoutStockAndRate: Login lockout history: login_security rate-limiters are Redis keys with no history.
unavailable.meteringPostFreeze: Metering posting freeze: admission fails open on transport errors and leaves no trace outside the log.

credits.title: Credits burnout
credits.note: Exhausted / low / unlimited are three mutually exclusive sets — unlimited is the ABSENCE of a grant. Burn rate is derived from resource_usage (compute_grants has no deduction ledger). ETA is linear extrapolation; unlimited and zero-burn both render —.

disk.title: Disk (this backend)
disk.note: Covers only this host's workspace_root. Remote devices and cloud machines have their own disks and are invisible here.

preview.title: Preview tunnels
preview.note: Process memory, cleared on restart. This process only, not platform-wide.

machines.title: Machine census
machines.note: Rows and state distribution across four ledgers, not a container count — one-container-per-room has no transport yet.

reliability.title: Delivery and events
reliability.note: Delivery backlog is stock, not a failure rate. Spool unread is an UPPER bound (reading is not consuming) and only sees this host's spool.

submit.title: Submit feedback

kind.label: What kind of feedback is this?

hint.suggestion: You want something to work better

submit.optionalDivider: Everything below is optional — write as much as you like. The more specific it is, the easier it is to reproduce and pick up.

bug.label: What happened
bug.placeholder: What you did, and what actually happened

suggestion.label: What's not working well
suggestion.placeholder: How it is now, and how you'd like it to be

expectation.label: What you expected
expectation.placeholder: The result you expected from the same action

repro.label: How to reproduce
repro.placeholder: The shortest sequence from opening the page to seeing the problem

visibility.label: Who can see it

public.title: Public
public.hint: Visible to every signed-in user; can be supported and commented on

private.title: Private
private.hintWithRoom: Only you, platform admins, and the people who were in the room where it was raised. It stays out of public lists and cannot be supported.
private.hintNoRoom: Only you and platform admins. It stays out of public lists and cannot be supported.

visibility.once: You decide this now, and only now — not even an admin has a way to make it public afterwards.

agent.title: From Cheese's investigation
agent.note: This feedback will be attributed to the AI teammate that found it, and you will be recorded as the submitter — both are kept, so "how much of what Cheese raised actually got filed" has an answer.
agent.attachHint: The context may contain your code snippets, file paths, or conversation text. With "Private", the people who can see it are you, platform admins, and the people who were in the room where it was raised.
